parameters.question: Compare factor loadings tables from Factor Analysis (number of factors chosen by parallel analysis, 100 iterations, 95th percentile, random_state=42). Each survey item's loading values must match the reference within +/-0.05. The sign of each factor may be flipped (a whole factor column multiplied by -1). Column order, factor order/naming, and item label formatting may differ, so align items by label and match factors by absolute loading pattern.
